alt: 考古人員從地下古室小心托出帶著泥土的青銅獸形器皿，器物正跨過陰影邊緣，重新映在陽光下。
scene_prompt: Archaeologists carefully bring a long-buried bronze animal vessel up from an excavated underground chamber into sunlight for the first time in centuries. One worker in the shaded opening supports the padded tray from below, another on the ground receives it; the vessel is halfway across the bright threshold and still bears traces of earth. The exposed layers of soil and buried chamber clearly establish that this was a hidden ancient artifact newly returned to the world, not an everyday object brought outside. Safe excavation, no readable ancient characters, no skulls.
